text: hi I'm a foster carer I've got a little boy 4 months old been with us a few weeks and I've just noticed some spots on him tiny little dots kind of purply red and a couple of bits that look like bruises I did the glass thing my partner said to do pressed the side of a glass on them and they didn't go away they stayed exactly the same colour I don't know if I'm overreacting it might be nothing but I've never seen it on him before
